WfdRtspSession.java adapts the WFD M1-M7 flow/capability handling from
miracast/WfdSessionHandler.kt. WfdTransport.java adapts TS PAT/PMT/PES
assembly from miracast/TsDemuxer.kt. Both are reworked for this project's
bounded standalone tests, ownership checks and existing playback pipeline.
No UI, root helper, subnet scanner or bundled SDK is incorporated.
Mirax source is not incorporated.
